'''Croy Winnis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked for the company [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Winnis eventually defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and he attempted to deliver some weapons technology to the Alliance. However, before he could complete his assignment, he became injured and received treatment inside the [[University Faculty Medical Center]] near to [[Lake Grallia]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] suspected Winnis of being a Rebel informant who had provided the Alliance with information that had allowed them to kidnap a team of [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]] designers, and a number of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were posted to stand guard outside Winnis' recovery room. The Alliance then hired a team of agents to retrieve Winnis from the medical center, before the Imperials could discover his true identity.<ref name="CatCW" />
